oca.role: CCTV Control Assistant & Tech Solutions Developer

Implemented automations with Python, Selenium, and C# to extract data without direct APIs, utilizing web scraping.
Built automated processes for generating operational emails, PDF reports, and Excel files using Python and VBA.
Developed frontend and backend features using React.js, Next.js, Laravel, PHP, and MySQL for enterprise web applications.
Optimized relational databases and SQL queries to improve the performance of internal processes and administrative reports.
Collaborated under agile Scrum methodology with IT and administration teams to develop and deploy solutions.
Implemented SEO improvements and participated in production web application deployments.
Participated in the development of web applications using React.js, Node.js, Laravel, and PostgreSQL.
Designed and modeled relational databases using MySQL Workbench and ERWIN Data Modeler.

Worked under agile methodologies collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
